key_findings: Deuteration of methadone (d9-methadone) increased plasma exposure, lowered brain-to-plasma ratio (suggesting reduced BBB transfer), and raised LD50 2.1-fold.
d9-methadone relieved postoperative mechanical hypersensitivity via peripheral opioid receptors at a dose where methadone was ineffective.
